payload.content: When computing a ratio, percentage, or rate between two integer columns (e.g. `count_a / count_b`), wrap the numerator with `CAST(... AS REAL)` so SQLite performs floating-point division rather than integer truncation: `CAST(a AS REAL) / b`.

rationale: vista_synthesis: substitutes CAST-as-REAL idiom for plain integer division on ratio questions; addresses a frequent silent-truncation failure.
